name: Monica and Friends
description: Monica, the leader of the crew and 'ruler of the street,' is a little girl with a strong personality, not one to overlook any insult. She absolutely loves her stuffed bunny, Samson, and takes him with her everywhere. Jimmy Five, one of her best friends, is a smart kid, but he's always provoking her. Maggy is Monica's best friend and a super cute girl, who is always eating watermelons. To complete the show's main quartet, enter Smudge, a skillful boy who is terrified of water.

Who Knocks?
videos.overview: All that Jimmy Five wants most on this beautiful morning is to watch his favourite cartoon on TV. But today, the gang will not give him peace! First Monica knocks on his door to sell raffle tickets, then Maggy wants his help to take care of her pet lobster, then Smudge needs to pee... ARGH!! Will Jimmy ever get peace?

videos.title: A Monster Cleanup
videos.overview: Monica goes to Magali's house and finds out that her little friend is very busy with the cleaning. But ... wait! Something is wrong, after all Dona Lili would never leave the house in the care of her daughter. Besides, this is not a child's job. While the two are arguing, a lady, beyond weird, and full of good intentions appears to help. Did this lady even come to lend a hand? Or is something very strange going on?

videos.title: The Tree House
videos.overview: Cascão is about to realize a child's dream, build a beautiful tree house. To help him accomplish this endeavor, Cascão found the ideal partner: Cebolinha, his faithful companion of infallible (or not so infallible) plans against Monica. And speaking of Mônica, our little friend can end this boys' dream or, who knows, give a nice helping hand in this endeavor.

videos.title: Owner of Half the Street
videos.overview: Cebolinha is not satisfied, as he just took a few more good rabbits from Monica. For him this is not fair, after all all the poor thing wants is to own the moon ... or better, the street. So Mônica has an idea to put an end to Cebolinha's "mimimi": she divides the street into two parts and gives him half. But did our toothpaste do the right thing? Owning half the street can raise Cebolinha's head and bring other conflicts to the gang. It will be?

videos.title: Coincidences
videos.overview: Cebolinha is euphoric, because he just came up with the best infallible plan against Monica of all time. So our little friend decided to share his great idea with his best friend and partner of all hours, Cascão. But Cascão no longer believes in the bald man, especially when his plan needs a series of events and coincidences to succeed. And now? Will Cebolinha be able to put his plan into practice or is he ... say "traveling on mayonnaise" again?

videos.title: All The Bunnies
videos.overview: While Mônica is playing house in her room, Cebolinha is hanging around her house, waiting for an opportunity to catch her bunny. Well, to facilitate the mission of our friend, here comes his faithful partner with unfailing plans, Cascão. But taking Samson can become an almost impossible mission, especially since our friends discover that Monica has not only a blue bunny, but dozens of them. And now? How to get rid of so many bunnies?

videos.title: King and Queen of the Street
videos.overview: Mônica is hosting a party for Saturday, and Mônica and Magali had a great idea to make the party more fun: electing the King and Queen of the Street. But to be elected, candidates must be the cutest boy and girl in the neighborhood. Of course, Cebolinha and Cascão will do everything possible and impossible to win this election. Will they succeed? And, after all, who will be the Queen? Anyway, many comings and goings and an unexpected and super fun ending to this thrilling adventure!

videos.title: The Noise Behind The Window
videos.overview: Cascão is sleeping peacefully when he is awakened by his friend Cebolinha, who is in his room, waking him from the most beautiful of dreams to live one of the biggest nightmares of his life. It is that an incessant knock on the bedroom window makes the boys terrified. Who will it be at this time of night? Who knows, Monica, crazy about life because they got one more trick out of her? Glup ...

videos.title: The False Friend Plan
videos.overview: Monica is very strange, wearing sunglasses and looking, distressed, for her friend Magali. Cebolinha and Cascão, curious to know what is going on with the small tooth, come up with another infallible plan to discover this mystery: one of the boys will have to impersonate his best friend and make Monica confess his secret. Will the boys' infallible plan succeed this time?

videos.title: Happy with my Toy
videos.overview: In this story, Cascão teaches a creativity class, transforming ordinary toys into characters of the most incredible adventures. A small plastic spaceship can become the space weapon that will defend the planet earth from evil alien invaders, a simple ball can be the most important symbol of the victory of a great sports team, among many other things. And so our hero proves that for a common toy to become magical, it only takes a little imagination!

videos.title: The Diner Poet
videos.overview: Cebolinha invited Cascão to eat a big hamburger in the neighborhood cafeteria. And all because of Cebolinha ... that is, as long as Cascão agrees to participate in another of his infallible plans against Monica, of course! But the toothpaste appears suddenly and worse (or better), with Bianca, her new neighbor, who left our little bit in love. Well, with so much love in her heart, Cebolinha keeps on creating poetry for the new muse. Um, now what? Did the infallible plan go to "second plan"?

videos.title: To Each Their Own Game
videos.overview: Cebolinha is not satisfied with the scenario of this episode. Besides being very simple, there are not many options for our friend to hide from Monica. So our friend has another brilliant idea: to transform the Lemon tree neighborhood into a great video game. Um ... well, Marina and her magic pencil could help and, best of all, she doesn't even need to know about her infallible plan. Eh, eh, eh ...

videos.title: A Witch's Cake
videos.overview: Magali is all pink because today is her birthday. Her mother prepared a beautiful party with lots of food and drinks and her Aunt Nena, the best cake maker in the neighborhood, is going to make the cake! Everything is cause for joy for our little friend, until her cousin Dudu makes a frightening revelation: Aunt Nena is a Witch, and her cake will turn Magali into a great bread loaf. And now? Is Dudu traveling on mayonnaise? Or is your sweet aunt really a wicked witch? Dum, dum, dum, dum ...

videos.title: A Very Crazy Joke
videos.overview: Monica fell for Bucky’s joke and is now bent on passing it forward, but it's not so easy for the queen of Lemon Tree Street to exercise her comedic talents. Does Mônica have a way with this "gotcha" story? What if the gang doesn't fall? Come and have fun with this super fun adventure from Turma da Mônica!

videos.title: Trojan Bunny
videos.overview: Trojan horse is the symbol of the war between Greeks and Trojans. The Greeks gave a giant wooden horse to the Trojans, who took it inside their fortress. When night fell, some Greek soldiers got out of the horse and took the city, winning the war. Inspired by this incredible story, Cebolinha came up with another surefire plan to catch Monica's bunny. And now? Will Cebolinha's plan work or will Cascão ruin it all over again?

videos.title: Club Meeting
videos.overview: The boys are gathered in the club for another extraordinary meeting. Cebolinha, the club president, wants to show his newest infallible plan against Monica, but Cascão has not yet appeared and the boys want to discuss other priorities, such as the need for an official anthem for the club, a new name and the construction from a bathroom to the headquarters, among other things. Time is running out and Cebolinha has already started to get impatient. Will the president get the group together to execute the new infallible plan?

videos.title: All Alone In the World
videos.overview: Jimmy Five went over the top in his playtime! His mother went crazy because of the mess, as a result he had to clean everything! And he even had to go to bed early. On that day, the most important day of his life, the day of his Birthday, all that Jimmy wants now is to be Alone in the World! Is this possible? Who could fulfil such a wish?
